name: Weekly Review & Reset
equipment: A calendar and your task list
instructions: Look back over the last week: which time management techniques from this program you actually used, and which you skipped.
Clear out completed and stale tasks from your list so next week starts from a clean, trustworthy view.
Pick the single technique that helped most this week and plan to lead with it again.
Watch today's video as a refresher on the time management fundamentals this program started with.
